acceptances.rationale: The advisory is limited to serveStatic double-decoding a request path. Mission Control's orchestration server imports only Hono() and serve() from @hono/node-server and never calls serveStatic. No 1.x patched release exists; the patched line is 2.1.3+, which requires Node >=20 and would raise the declared Node >=18 floor. High-severity findings are not accepted.
controls: no serveStatic import or call in apps/orchestration-server
orchestration exposes JSON API routes only
SDK override keeps @hono/node-server on 1.19.17 rather than resolving 2.x
hono itself is patched to 4.13.11 for the related serveStatic advisory 1242595
acceptances.migrationPlan: Upgrade @hono/node-server to 2.1.3+ when the repository Node floor moves to 20 or when a patched 1.x release exists.
